# Dell Alienware 16 Area-51 current offer — SRC-0224

## Source

https://www.dell.com/nl-be/shop/gaming-and-games/alienware-16-area-51-gaminglaptop/spd/alienware-area-51-aa16250-gaming-laptop/aa16250_cto5?view=configurations

## What it proves

The Belgian `aa16250_cto5` RTX 5080/32GB/1TB/OLED configuration is currently €4348.79. It includes only 12 months of Alienware Care next-business-day onsite service. Dell bundles a USB-C-to-2.5GbE adapter rather than an integrated RJ45 port. It therefore fails the buyer's integrated-RJ45 gate and cannot fit a second laptop or an unpriced three-year support extension under the pair ceiling.
